about: Ormi LoRA pose picks (FFX-2 only, Chapter 6). Tags are renders under D:/Tools/pyrefly-lora/ormi/poses/<state>/. Boxes are in RAW-frame pixels (sheet.py subtracts the installed cropBox). Scores follow sets/ormi/round3/judge.md: each criterion 0 to 10, the score is the worst, the bar is 7. Redo of 2026-09-23 after the independent judge (../judge.md): attack, hurt and ko edited as the judge named (redo.md); cast unchanged. The redo scores are the painter's own; an independent judge is still owed. Every state below 7 is 'best available, below bar'.
